purpose: Verified public US parcel polygon adapters; not nationwide completeness
notes: Viewport-only queries on toggle and camera move-end, not continuous polling. Prefer cached tiles where official and usable.
Honor exceededTransferLimit: page resultOffset in stable object-ID order or recursively subdivide viewport; expose truncation and source failures.
Use explicit terrain-clamped polygon-ring polylines on each basemap; Cesium polygon outlines can disappear when ground-clamped and width support is platform-dependent.
Keep toggle on at wider zoom, display zoom-needed message instead of disabling it; fetch high-detail polygons only at neighborhood-scale.
Never infer ownership from taxpayer or owner-type categories; suppress placeholders and honor redacted names.
Approximate bounding boxes only route requests; data gaps remain visible and must not be described as no parcels exist.

adapters.name: Harris County Appraisal District

suppressOwnerWhen.notes: No coded domain supplied. Treat any unrecognized nonempty flag as withheld rather than guessing its meaning.

adapters.name: Travis County Tax Maps

adapters.boundsMeaning: Approximate routing envelope, not complete coverage guarantee
adapters.notes: py_owner_name metadata alias is Physical Owner Name; py does not mean prior year. This is the County public tax map API. Separate TCAD website maps page prohibits data mining; do not crawl it; use permitted official GIS API and offered bulk exports.
